plants.name: Tulsi
plants.benefits: Traditionally valued for wellness and daily herbal use.
plants.growing: Warm, sunny conditions with regular moisture and good drainage.
plants.description: Tulsi is a sacred herb known for its aromatic leaves and easy cultivation.
plants.medicine_properties: Used in traditional wellness practices; safety depends on preparation and dose.

plants.name: Neem
plants.benefits: Traditionally used for topical and household applications.
plants.growing: Thrives in warm climates with full sun and well-drained soil.
plants.description: Neem is a fast-growing tree with bitter leaves and a long medicinal tradition.
plants.medicine_properties: Leaves and oil are used in traditional preparations; not all products are interchangeable.

plants.name: Aloe Vera
plants.benefits: Often used in topical skin-care products.
plants.growing: Prefers bright light and low-water, well-drained conditions.
plants.description: Aloe vera is a succulent with fleshy leaves and a well-known gel.
plants.medicine_properties: Leaf gel is commonly used topically, but latex and gel differ in safety.
